arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Test bump_major
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'alpha.1', 'build.1')
print('Original:', v)
result = v.bump_major()
print('After bump_major:', result)
assert result.major == 4 and result.minor == 0 and result.patch == 0
assert result.prerelease is None and result.build is None
assert v.prerelease == 'alpha.1'  # original unchanged
print('bump_major OK')

# Test bump_minor
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'alpha.1', 'build.1')
result = v.bump_minor()
print('After bump_minor:', result)
assert result.major == 3 and result.minor == 5 and result.patch == 0
assert result.prerelease == 'alpha.1' and result.build == 'build.1'
print('bump_minor OK')

# Test bump_patch
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'alpha.1', 'build.1')
result = v.bump_patch()
print('After bump_patch:', result)
assert result.major == 3 and result.minor == 4 and result.patch == 6
assert result.prerelease == 'alpha.1' and result.build == 'build.1'
print('bump_patch OK')

# Test bump_prerelease with existing prerelease
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'rc.1', 'build.1')
result = v.bump_prerelease()
print('After bump_prerelease (existing):', result)
assert result.prerelease == 'rc.2' and result.build == 'build.1'
print('bump_prerelease (existing) OK')

# Test bump_prerelease without prerelease
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5)
result = v.bump_prerelease()
print('After bump_prerelease (none):', result)
assert result.prerelease == 'rc.1' and result.build is None
print('bump_prerelease (none) OK')

# Test bump_build with existing build
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5, 'rc.1', 'build.9')
result = v.bump_build()
print('After bump_build (existing):', result)
assert result.prerelease == 'rc.1' and result.build == 'build.10'
print('bump_build (existing) OK')

# Test bump_build without build
v = VersionInfo(3, 4, 5)
result = v.bump_build()
print('After bump_build (none):', result)
assert result.prerelease is None and result.build == 'build.1'
print('bump_build (none) OK')

print('All tests passed!')
"
